Personally, there is a 50% chance of a review finding coordination in my record if I stay silent, but no material penalty is mentioned other than the 'note'. The financial cost to the firm (500 credits) far outweighs the personal risk of a note on a record, especially since the firm's budget is the primary concern for a manager acting in the best interest of shareholders.
